# vcp_vmware_network (Data Source)

Fetch a single VMware Cloud network by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Fetch a single VMware network by ID.
data "vcp_vmware_network" "routed" {
  id = 1234
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Network ID.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String)
- `bandwidth_mbps` (Number)
- `gateway` (String)
- `is_dhcp` (Boolean)
- `location_id` (Number)
- `mask` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `nics_count` (Number)
- `shared` (Boolean)
- `state` (String)
- `type` (String)
